market: DAL −4.5, total 51.5. Dak 33.5 attempts / 22.5 completions; Daniel Jones 31.5 / 20.5. Javonte Williams 17.5 carries; Jonathan Taylor 14.5.
lineup: George Pickens (hamstring) and TE Jake Ferguson are questionable for DAL; KaVontae Turpin and S Jalen Thompson are out. IND is sticking with Daniel Jones after scoring 10 and 7 points the last two weeks.
branches: Pickens out: Lamb's share, already 39–46% the last two weeks, climbs further. Pickens active and healthy: the receiving reads below lose most of their edge.

keys.take: Jonathan Taylor. He's the only thing working in IND's offense (95 yards in each of Weeks 6–7).
keys.how: DAL's run defense isn't built to stop him: 5.22 yards per carry allowed, the worst of the 14 defenses here. Its plan has been to win the scoreboard.
keys.gives: Run lanes, plus 30 QB rushing yards a game.
keys.counter: DAL scores and IND has to throw. In the 42–7 loss to JAX, Taylor had 8 carries.

keys.take: CeeDee Lamb, at a 39–46% target share the last two weeks.
keys.how: IND blitzes only 20.8% and allows the fewest WR targets of these defenses (15.8 a game). It's a zone-and-rally approach.
keys.gives: Underneath volume to the alpha receiver and the run. DAL ran 38–39 times in each of the last two weeks.
keys.counter: DAL runs Javonte into a defense allowing 5.11 yards per carry.

scripts.control: DAL leads. Javonte gets 24–25 carries (as in Weeks 7–8), Dak's attempts drop to 27–29, Lamb's share holds but volume dips, and Taylor's carries shrink.
scripts.competitive: Taylor gets 18–24 carries against the league's worst-per-carry run defense. Lamb's 11–12 targets are steady.
scripts.reversal: IND leads on Taylor. Dak throws 42–54 times (his three losses averaged 43 attempts) and Lamb's ceiling opens (17 catches against HOU).

plays.cond: Only if George Pickens is inactive or listed limited at 51¢ or less. If Pickens plays fully, pass.
plays.why: Pickens' hamstring has concentrated Dak's targets in Lamb, and every script except a DAL blowout keeps his volume.
plays.support: Lamb's target share was 46% and 39% the last two weeks. Pickens has had hamstring tightness in games (Rotoballer, Nov 3–4).
plays.sample: 7+ catches in 5 of 8, and 11–12 targets in each of the last three.
plays.counter: IND allows the fewest WR targets here, and DAL's run-heavy turn caps the passing.
plays.loses: DAL builds a lead and runs 38 times again, so Lamb sees 8 targets.
plays.vs: Preferred over 90+ yards (46¢). The catch count tracks the target share. The yards need explosives IND rarely allows.

value: Lamb 7+ at 51¢ (needs 53%), only in the Pickens-out branch

passed.name: Jonathan Taylor 60+ rush (54¢), either side
passed.why: He topped 60 in 6 of 8 against weaker run defenses than DAL's, but the books expect only 14.5 carries and our backtest leans No. The matchup and the script cancel.

passed.name: Javonte Williams 70+ rush (55¢)
passed.why: DAL's turn to the run and IND's 5.11 yards per carry help, but he topped 70 only in the 155-yard game.
passed.move: Ferguson inactive (more 12-personnel runs) plus a price of 50¢ or less.

passed.name: Tyler Warren 5+ rec (60¢)
passed.why: A 33% share last week and the trailing script fit, but at 60¢ there's no room.

passed.name: Daniel Jones 200+ pass yds
passed.why: IND's offense has scored 17 points in two weeks. No signal either way.

sources.t: Rotoballer — Daniel Jones to remain Colts' starter
Rotoballer — Pickens has hamstring tightening up in games
